description:
Luna Eclipse — folding full-suspension fat bike
The Eclipse is Luna's most affordable ebike and its first hub-motor bike — a folding, full-suspension fat bike with some attitude. The battery hides in the downtube and the hub motor is nearly silent, so it stays stealthy; it adjusts to fit any rider, folds down for small-space storage and transport, and is road legal in all 50 states.

Bafang 750W rear hub motor — assists to 22 mph, geared low for torque and hills
Gates Carbon CDX belt drive — maintenance-free, silent, no grease
48V 14Ah LG MJ1 battery (672Wh) — hidden in the downtube
Big Boy Fat 20×4.25 tires with 4" coil suspension front and rear
Folds for storage and transport; weighs 55 lb

Specifications

Motor
Bafang rear hub, 750W, assists to 22 mph

Battery
48V 14Ah LG MJ1 cells, 672Wh, hidden in downtube

Drivetrain
Gates Carbon CDX belt, 55T chainring / 20T rear cog, single speed

Frame
Aluminum alloy folding; polished clear-coat or powder-coat black

Fork
YDH 4" travel coil, adjustable compression + lockout

Rear shock
Coil, 4" travel (150mm eye-to-eye, 45mm stroke)

Gates CDX belt drive
Most bikes at this price run a chain. The Eclipse runs the same Gates Carbon CDX belt found on premium commuters costing three times as much: carbon-fiber cords that don't stretch, a polyurethane body that doesn't rust, and no lubrication, ever. No grease on your clothes or in your trunk, no chain slap when you fold it, and nothing to degrease after a sandy or salty ride. It runs near-silent, which pairs with the quiet hub motor — and combined with low gearing and 20" wheels, the Eclipse climbs hills better than most hub-motor bikes. 55T front, 20T rear, single speed.

Luna 21-piece tool kit — $30

Road legal in all 50 states. The buyer takes full responsibility for proper use of this product.
